long_biography.plain_text:
Trained in economics, Jeffrey Alan Leerink shaped a career at the boundary between medicine and finance. He established a securities firm whose analysts specialized in health care, then co-created MEDACorp to bring physicians' commercial insight into investment decisions. He also helped launch Humedica, a health-data company later acquired by Optum.

Leerink remained chief executive when Silicon Valley Bank acquired his business. He subsequently headed the employee group that repurchased it, bringing back the Leerink Partners name under independent ownership. He also formed Leerink Capital Partners to extend his sector expertise into asset management. These ventures reflect a consistent approach: pair close knowledge of medical markets with financial advice and investment.
